typed_links.link: The twelve Ebal curses split because each closes with its own discrete performative response (ve-amar kol ha-am amen, 11x verbatim with the v.15 plural variant); the 28:38-42 futile-labor items merge because the chain runs with no per-item closure. The closure formula, not offense-count, is the differentiating criterion.

The vehaya ki head opens a unit where a topic or scene reset accompanies it (11:13, 11:29 after the 11:28|29 split) and stays list-internal where none does (15:16); at 17:18 (M8-Deut-101) the bare head without a reset left the seam at insufficient_evidence.

The two-move opening (elleh heading followed by vayyiqra Moshe el kol Yisrael) occurs exactly twice, 4:45->5:1 and MT 28:69->29:1; both sites are treated as unit-opening, and the parallel raised 194's confidence to medium with the setumah-before/petuchah-after counter-signal disclosed.
